label: Upbit (업비트)
terms_note: Quotation (public) API only, no key. Docs in Korean (docs.upbit.com/kr) and English (global-docs.upbit.com), HTML only. Quotation calls are limited per second per IP and group (live 2026-10-01: header Remaining-Req: group=ticker; min=600; sec=8; the docs: 10 per second for the market/ticker/candle groups). Ticker answers a list (one element per market). An unknown market answers 404 {"error":{"name":404,"message":"Code not found"}}. Candle times are given without a zone (candle_date_time_utc); the server appends Z.

list_markets.note: Every market as QUOTE-BASE (KRW-BTC, BTC-ETH, USDT-XRP) with Korean and English names in raw; query matches the code or either name.

get_ticker.note: symbol is a market code such as KRW-BTC (quote first). Upbit's ticker carries no bid/ask (they are in the orderbook endpoint).

get_candles.note: interval: 1m 3m 5m 10m 15m 30m 1h 4h 1d 1w 1M; up to 200 candles, newest first.

not_offered.me: Exchange API calls need an access key and a JWT signed with the secret key; public-data entry only.
not_offered.get_balances: GET /v1/accounts needs a JWT-authenticated key; public-data entry only.
not_offered.list_orders: GET /v1/orders/open needs a JWT-authenticated key; public-data entry only.
not_offered.place_order: POST /v1/orders needs a JWT-authenticated key and spends money; not mapped.
not_offered.cancel_order: DELETE /v1/order needs a JWT-authenticated key; not mapped.
